dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, how can I learn more vocabulary?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈlɜːrn ˈmɔːr voʊˈkæbjəlɛri?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You'd better make flashcards. Write a new word on each card.
dialogue.reading: juːd ˈbɛtər ˈmeɪk ˈflæʃkɑːrdz. ˈraɪt ə ˈnuː ˈwɜːrd ɑːn ˈiːtʃ ˈkɑːrd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And then should I memorize them?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈðɛn ʃʊd aɪ ˈmɛməraɪz ðɛm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. Look at them every day, and repeat the words many times.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈlʊk ət ðɛm ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ, ənd rɪˈpiːt ðə ˈwɜːrdz ˈmɛni ˈtaɪmz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Should I translate every word into Thai?
dialogue.reading: ʃʊd aɪ trænsˈleɪt ˈɛvri ˈwɜːrd ɪntə ˈtaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You'd better not translate everything. Try to think in English.
dialogue.reading: juːd ˈbɛtər ˈnɑːt trænsˈleɪt ˈɛvriθɪŋ. ˈtraɪ tə ˈθɪŋk ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What about new words in a book? Should I look them up?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈnuː ˈwɜːrdz ɪn ə ˈbʊk? ʃʊd aɪ ˈlʊk ðɛm ˈʌp?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, but you'd better not look up every word. Try to understand the word from the other words first.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt juːd ˈbɛtər ˈnɑːt ˈlʊk ˈʌp ˈɛvri ˈwɜːrd. ˈtraɪ tə ˌʌndərˈstænd ðə ˈwɜːrd frəm ði ˈʌðər ˈwɜːrdz ˈfɜːrst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'd better start today. My exam is next month!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪd ˈbɛtər ˈstɑːrt təˈdeɪ. maɪ ɪɡˈzæm ɪz ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ!
